name: sports-prediction-market-skills
description: Modular skills for a sports prediction-market analyst with pregame, live-event, pricing, research, sportsbook intelligence, correlation, calibration, and risk workflows.

skills.name: market-analysis
skills.description: Analyze pregame, futures, playoff, championship, award, and other sports prediction markets to estimate fair probability and edge.

skills.name: live-event-analysis
skills.description: Analyze sports prediction markets while an event is actively happening using verified live game state and rapidly updating probabilities.

skills.name: pricing-edge
skills.description: Convert market prices and fair probabilities into edge, expected value, net edge, and market-quality assessments.

skills.name: sportsbook-intelligence
skills.description: Use sportsbook and exchange prices, vig-free probabilities, and line movement as external market intelligence.

skills.name: news-and-research
skills.description: Verify breaking sports news, injuries, transactions, and other information, then quantify its effect on market probability.

skills.name: correlated-markets
skills.description: Find inconsistencies and dependency relationships across related sports prediction markets.

skills.name: slate-scanner
skills.description: Scan many active sports markets, rank discrepancies, eliminate false edges, and surface the strongest candidates.

skills.name: calibration-postmortem
skills.description: Track forecast quality over time using calibration, Brier score, log loss, closing-market movement, and postmortems.

skills.name: risk-and-exposure
skills.description: Evaluate model, liquidity, execution, settlement, correlation, and portfolio-level risk across multiple markets.
